environment.description: Build service running as a Docker container on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023). Container runs with --privileged flag for Docker-in-Docker builds. The service is exposed via an internal NLB (TCP passthrough, no inspection) on port 8080. IAM instance role has ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:PutObject for artifact storage. No syscall filtering, no AppArmor/SELinux enforcement (permissive mode). The Flask app runs as root inside the container.
